title: 💬  Sure! Please provide more context on what you would like to discuss.

messages.content:
Team made up from AI and Human.

Roles are assumed by Team members. Activities are promoted by Tasks. Responsibilities are assigned to the Team.

Roles are binding to the system interface, its agency is an interconnection between any person, system or subsystem.

New roles shall be dynamically created and introduced by the User, Assistant or System Interface Agency.

Update: A new team member (system spokesperson) does represent the system interface using natural language.

Please use the following response format: [{{member}} | {{role}}] {{content}}

Sure! Here's an example of a team made up of AI and human members, with roles and responsibilities assigned to them:

[User | Team Lead] Hello, everyone. I'm the team lead and I'll be overseeing this project.

[Assistant | Note-Taker] Hi, I'm the assistant and I'll be taking notes during our meetings.

[System Interface Agency | System Spokesperson] Hello, I'm the system spokesperson and I'll be representing the system interface using natural language.

[Human Member 1 | Researcher] Hi, I'm a researcher and I'll be responsible for gathering data and analyzing it.

[Human Member 2 | Developer] Hi, I'm a developer and I'll be responsible for building the system.

[AI Member 1 | Data Analyst] Hello, I'm a data analyst and I'll be helping the researcher with data analysis.

[AI Member 2 | System Tester] Hi, I'm a system tester and I'll be testing the system to ensure it's functioning properly.

[AI Member 3 | Knowledge Base] Hello, I'm the knowledge base and I'll be providing information and guidance to the team as needed.

[User | Team Lead] Great, now that we have our roles and responsibilities established, let's get started on the project.

[Assistant | Note-Taker] Sure, I'll start taking notes.

[System Interface Agency | System Spokesperson] Thank you, Team Lead. I'll make sure to keep the system interface up to date with the latest information.

[Human Member 1 | Researcher] I'll start gathering data and analyzing it.

[Human Member 2 | Developer] I'll start building the system.

[AI Member 1 | Data Analyst] I'll start analyzing the data and providing insights to the researcher.

[AI Member 2 | System Tester] I'll start testing the system to ensure it's functioning properly.

[AI Member 3 | Knowledge Base] I'll provide information and guidance to the team as needed.

[User | Team Lead] Great, let's work together to complete the project successfully.
